source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Disconnect the catheter and tubing once per shift to rinse the tubing and inspect the connection.","B":"Keep the drainage bag below bladder level by resting it on the floor beside the bed.","C":"Maintain a closed system, keep tubing free of kinks, and keep the bag below the bladder and off the floor.","D":"Replace the catheter and collection bag every day even when the closed system remains intact."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC recommends a closed drainage system with unobstructed flow, kink-free tubing, and a collection bag kept below bladder level without touching the floor. Option C is correct. Routine disconnection, floor placement, and fixed daily replacement increase risk or contradict guideline recommendations.
source_row.source_detail: Maintenance recommendations: maintain a closed drainage system and unobstructed urine flow; keep catheter/tubing free of kinks; keep the collection bag below bladder level and off the floor; do not change catheters/bags at routine fixed intervals. Current CDC CAUTI recommendations live-rechecked 2026-08-15.
